svg.title: BCNF Lossless Decomposition and Semi-Naive Datalog Fixed-Point Evaluation
svg.desc: Animated two-panel diagram illustrating Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF) decomposition of relation R(Student, Course, Instructor) along violating functional dependency Instructor to Course into lossless R1 and R2, paired with Semi-Naive Datalog incremental delta fixed-point evaluation over a directed edge graph until delta equals the empty set.
svg.text: BCNF Lossless Decomposition & Semi-Naive Datalog Fixed-Point Evaluation
Eliminating FD redundancy via superkey splits (X → Y) alongside incremental ΔR^(k) = R^(k) \ R^(k-1) transitive closure
∀ non-trivial X → Y, X is superkey
Relation R(Student, Course, Instructor) — Candidate Key: {Student, Course}

g.text: Lossless-Join Invariant Verified: R1 ⋈ R2 = R (Zero Spurious Tuples)
A(R1) ∩ A(R2) = {Instructor} and Instructor → A(R1) = {Instructor, Course}
Common attribute forms a superkey of R1. Note: BCNF sacrifices preserving {Student, Course} → Instructor across tables.

svg.text: r1: ΔReach^(k+1)(x, z) ← ΔReach^(k)(x, y), Edge(y, z) \ Reach^(k)
Seed from EDB Edge. Accumulated R^(0) = ΔR^(0) (3 tuples).

g.text: Joins ONLY ΔR^(0) ⋈ Edge → derives 2-hop paths without re-scanning R^(0).
Joins ONLY ΔR^(1) ⋈ Edge → derives 3-hop path (1,4). R^(2) = 6 tuples.
Monotonic T_P stops cleanly at Knaster-Tarski Least Fixed Point (all 6 reachable pairs computed once).
